events.text: The death toll in the market drone attack in Abyei rises to 220.
The Sudanese Army says that they have repelled an attack by the Rapid Support Forces and Sudan People's Liberation Movement–North (SPLM–N) on the Blue Nile state.
The Rapid Support Forces launches a drone strike on a power plant in Tendelti in Sudan's White Nile State, knocking out the main transition line connecting North Kordofan.
At least 14 people are killed and 20 others are injured after a bus and a truck collide head-on in Natore District, Bangladesh.
Twelve people are killed and 30 others are injured after a bus crashes into a truck near Cairo, Egypt.
Nigeria announces its first case of Ebola virus in the epidemic.
Libya's eastern-based House of Representatives approves a 2019 maritime boundary agreement with Turkey and repeals two 2020 decisions that rejected the accord.
South Korea withdraws additional embassy staff from Ukraine following a dispute over two captured North Korean soldiers who were transferred to South Korea.

events.topic: Houthi–Saudi conflict, Saudi Arabia–United Kingdom relations
events.text: United Kingdom says it will deploy RAF Typhoons to help Saudis defend against Houthi attacks.

A United States federal judge sentences a Guatemalan national to 30 years in prison for helping organize a 2022 migrant-smuggling operation in San Antonio, Texas, that left 53 migrants dead and 11 injured.
